(1) the use of suggestions is more frequent at the beginning of the search sessions; (2) English suggestions are preferred to native language suggestions, regardless of the users’ English proficiency; and (3) medico-scientic suggestions are preferred to lay suggestions, regardless of users’ health literacy.
